gloss: popular edition; affordable edition; mass-market version

definitions.gloss: popular edition; affordable edition; mass-market version
definitions.explanation: A lower-priced, widely available edition of a book or publication, designed for broad distribution rather than collectors or specialists. Often smaller in format, with simpler binding.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{辞典|じてん}→辞典：01640_jiten⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{普及版|ふきゅうばん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: A popular edition of this dictionary was released.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{普及版|ふきゅうばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お⟦{勧|すす}め→勧める：02120_susumeru⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I recommend the affordable edition for students.

examples.japanese: ⟦{豪華版|ごうかばん}→豪華版：24861_goukaban⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{高|たか}すぎた⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{発売|はつばい}→発売：04315_hatsubai⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧{普及版|ふきゅうばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: The deluxe edition was too expensive, so I bought the popular edition that came out later.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{普及|ふきゅう}→普及：07592_fukyuu⟧ (dissemination/spread) + {版|ばん} (edition). The emphasis is on making content accessible to a wide audience at a reasonable price. Common in publishing for books, dictionaries, and encyclopedias.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {普及版|ふきゅうばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to release a popular edition
- {普及版|ふきゅうばん}⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧: affordable-edition pricing
- ⟦{新書|しんしょ}→新書：16406_shinsho⟧{普及版|ふきゅうばん}: mass-market paperback edition

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{豪華版|ごうかばん}→豪華版：24861_goukaban⟧: deluxe edition — the higher-end counterpart
- {文庫版|ぶんこばん}: pocket paperback edition — specifically the small A6-format paperbacks common in Japan
- {通常版|つうじょうばん}: standard edition — neutral term without the "affordable" connotation
- {廉価版|れんかばん}: bargain edition — explicitly emphasizes low price
